#Region "Main"
Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Starting web automation''' Icon: Display.Icon.None Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
WebAutomation.LaunchFirefox Url: $'''https://example.com''' WindowStyle: WebAutomation.BrowserWindowStyle.Normal ClearCache: False ClearCookies: False
    WebAutomation.FillTextByText Text: $'''username''' FillWith: $'''%Username%'''
    WebAutomation.FillTextByText Text: $'''password''' FillWith: $'''%Password%'''
    WebAutomation.ClickByText Text: $'''Sign in'''
WAIT 2
    WebAutomation.GetElementByText Text: $'''Welcome'''
WebAutomation.ClickByText Text: $'''Dashboard'''
WebAutomation.GetDetailsOfElement Attribute: $'''href''' StoreTo: %DashboardUrl%
WebAutomation.CloseWindow
IF %DashboardUrl% = $'''https://example.com/dashboard''' THEN
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Login successful''' Icon: Display.Icon.Information Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
ELSE
    Display.ShowMessageBox Message: $'''Login failed''' Icon: Display.Icon.Warning Buttons: Display.Buttons.OK DefaultButton: Display.DefaultButton.Button1 IsTopMost: False
END
SET Username TO $'''admin'''
SET Password TO $'''super-secret-password'''
#EndRegion
